verdict.rationale: Runway documents native high-resolution output: 1080p generation on Seedance 2.5, enhancing draft previews to 1080p, unlimited 4K upscaling, and in-product delivery formats including ProRes, PNG sequence and 10-bit HDR profiles. Together these cover the resolution and no-re-encoding parts of the story. However, nothing in the evidence documents selectable 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 aspect ratios, which is half of what the story asks for. Ads publishing to Meta, Google and TikTok only implies channel-ready formats. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 16:9/9:16/1:1 aspect-ratio selection, per-model resolution/aspect matrix, independent or hands-on corroboration of export quality.
